public_rationale: A survey published before the post supports substantial disappointment among organizational adopters. The coverage record also contains examples of attention to real users and disappointing products: Hard Fork featured workplace experiences, and Newton criticized the Humane Ai Pin. These examples cannot settle a frequency claim. Without a representative body of coverage and a denominator, the evidence establishes neither that customers were rarely mentioned nor that they were discussed regularly. The supported disappointment component does not settle the full claim.
limitations: The survey was commissioned by an AI vendor and measures adoption disappointment, which can include organizational problems as well as product shortcomings.
Many respondents also reported benefits and optimism; those findings can coexist with substantial disappointment.
The Humane evidence comes from a reputable secondary quotation because the original article could not be read.
Search results are not a representative sample of coverage.

our_interpretation: The surrounding paragraph identifies the relevant coverage as AI-progress discussion by pundits such as Roose, Newton and Cowen.
The ordinary reading is that customer experiences receive infrequent attention, while substantial numbers of customers experience disappointment. Many does not necessarily mean a majority.
Customers includes organizational adopters and individual users; vendor executives discussing their own products do not substitute for customer experiences.
The target is the public coverage and customer experience observable through April 7, 2025. This is the latest public state before publication; no beginning is specified.
Rarely is a frequency claim. Isolated examples cannot establish either rare or regular coverage.
criteria.support_condition: A representative or complete record shows infrequent customer discussion in the relevant coverage, and credible evidence establishes substantial dissatisfaction among actual users or organizational adopters.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A representative or complete record shows regular customer discussion, or sufficiently representative customer evidence rules out substantial dissatisfaction. A few mentions or many satisfied customers alone do not suffice.
